intended_use: Cross-domain permit validity must use the explicit time authority.
expected: A permit whose validity interval is declared in another clock domain is accepted only after a declared source->destination mapping resolves the caller's time, and is rejected with MissingMapping when no mapping is declared.
setup: A TimeAuthority with a declared source->destination mapping (offset plus tolerance) and a permit whose validity interval is declared in a foreign clock domain; the caller's time is resolved through the declared mapping before any validity or action comparison.
observed: Internal worker CTest run (sandbox): the 5 unit case IDs NOM-03, NOM-04, CLK-06, CLK-07, CLK-08 and the 1 integration test Integration.MappedValidityCrossDomainLifecycle all passed (part of T4 107/107 unit and T5 4/4 integration; 0 failures). MissingMapping is asserted when no mapping is declared.
limitation: Internal worker evidence only; only the bounded clock-domain interface slice is exercised. Hard real-time proof remains deferred to protected host verification (XVE-SYS-0147 partial).
